# Listing Mend

> Google Business Profile setup, repair, suspension appeal help and monthly upkeep for local service businesses (plumbers, HVAC, roofers, cleaners, contractors and similar) in Oklahoma and North Texas. Run by Jon, based in Lawton, OK. All work is done remotely.

## Contact and booking
- Start with a free 15-minute listing check: https://listingmend.com/#contact
- Call or text: (405) 458-9758. Missed calls are returned within one business day.
- Email: help@listingmend.com
- Hours (Central): Monday to Friday 9 AM to 8:30 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 5 PM, closed Sunday.
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=15102841345179544558
- How it works: free check, the owner adds Listing Mend as a Manager on the profile (no password needed), the work is done, the owner gets a handover checklist.
- Payment: card, by Square invoice.

## Services and prices (USD)
- Starter Setup: $249 one-time. Create or claim the profile, guided verification, categories, service area, hours, services, description, photos, review link and QR code.
- Listing Rescue: $449 one-time. Everything in Starter Setup, plus duplicate cleanup, suspension appeal help, and fixing business info on Apple, Bing and Yelp.
- Suspension Appeal: $199 one-time, paid up front.
- Keep-It-Clean: $129/month, cancel anytime. Four posts a month, review-reply drafts the owner approves, a monthly check-up and suspension watch.
- Pilot pricing for the first 5 clients: Starter $149, Rescue $349, Keep-It-Clean $79/month locked for 12 months. See https://listingmend.com/#pilot

## Service area
Oklahoma and North Texas, starting with Lawton and Comanche County.

## Policies
- The business owner keeps ownership of the profile.
- No fake reviews. No ranking guarantees.
- Google makes the final decision on suspensions and verification.

## Free resource
- Suspended or just unverified? A 10-point self-check, based on Google's help pages: https://listingmend.com/self-check.html
